constructionProjects.description: Groups works by the tag given to buildings and roads, and totals their cost and duration. Show/hide settings last only for this session and are not saved.
constructionProjects.empty: No tagged buildings or roads yet. Add a tag from a detail panel.
constructionProjects.stalledWarning: {{count}} work(s) will not progress because the construction speed is 0 (excluded from the duration total).
constructionProjects.showTag: Show this project in the 3D view
constructionProjects.hideTag: Hide this project in the 3D view
constructionProjects.confirmDeleteTag: Delete the tag "{{tag}}"? It will be removed from its buildings and roads (the works themselves remain).
